style.prompt: Original elegant modern chibi mystery comic, adult heroine, fine ink lines, painterly backgrounds, cold rainy blue and warm amber practical lights, expressive restrained acting. No slides or caption bands.

characters.name: 小宁
characters.appearance: adult woman, straight black bob hair, amber eyes, navy raincoat

versions.base: navy raincoat, ivory sweater, brown messenger bag

pages.purpose: 泛黄的信从多年无人居住的屋里滑出，引出悬念

panels.source_quote: 一封泛黄的信就从门缝里滑了出来。
panels.scene: Night rain, old wooden entrance door, heroine on right, a yellow envelope at the threshold; leave quiet upper-left space
panels.action: A yellow envelope slides from under the closed door

texts.text:
一封泛黄的信，
从门缝里滑了出来。

panels.source_quote: 背面是母亲熟悉的字迹
panels.scene: Amber-lit room, heroine holding an old envelope on right, no readable lettering on envelope; upper left quiet space
panels.action: She recognizes the handwriting on the envelope

pages.purpose: 用整页建立关键道具和地下室线索

panels.source_quote: 底下果然躺着一把黄铜钥匙。
panels.scene: Old kitchen at night, lifted floor tile and a brass key foreground, heroine kneels on right in amber light; quiet upper-left corner
panels.action: She lifts the tile and discovers a brass key

texts.text:
地砖下，
真的藏着一把黄铜钥匙。

pages.purpose: 整页路线示例：门内声音与现实冲突，在未解处停止

reader.known: 信让她不要回答门里的人
reader.new: 门内传来父亲的声音，但父亲在外地

panels.source_quote: 可父亲昨天才给我打过电话，说他还在外地出差。
panels.scene: Blue basement door at night, sliver of warm light under it, heroine on right holding brass key, left wall for narration
panels.action: She covers her mouth and stops before the blue door

texts.text: 门里传来了父亲的声音。

texts.speaker: ning
texts.text:
可父亲明明
还在外地出差……
